A_no_recent_filing_event.reason: A complete three-window pre-entry candidate dump is not persisted for all trend/breakout/earnings candidates; measuring this requires a candidate-level dump or default-off tagging harness.

B_positive_filing_shock.interpretation: Rejected as a C-strategy revival path; positive reaction after results 8-K was not drift-positive.

C_negative_filing_shock.interpretation: Most promising direction, but current evidence supports default-off forward observation / LLM grading, not core slot promotion.

D_unclear_or_missing_data.interpretation: Missingness is mainly ticker/price coverage, same-accession XBRL, and structured semantic fields.

positive_results_8k.interpretation: Rejected as a C-strategy revival path; positive reaction after results 8-K was not drift-positive.

scarce_slot_opportunity_cost: Current SEC branches are not proven core slot competitors: positive results-8K replacement proxy was -9.8719pp; SEC negative text reaction active-slot proxy was only +0.9943pp with 53.85% positive; leadership negative-reaction slot proxy was -6.9495pp.
next_minimum_action: Freeze current SEC schemas and collect forward queue replacement outcomes; if continuing research, test LLM semantic grading on the existing filing-text packet rather than reaction or keyword threshold sweeps.
decision_rationale: Data availability is materially improved, but prior same-family results reject simple positive earnings/SEC reaction, simple Companyfacts scoring, and keyword-positive text. The only promising negative-shock branches lack enough replacement value for production promotion.
